test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Each of the six graduate students, Anudeep, Yamuna, Chinmayi, Divija, Esha and Guna, has an online PG entrance exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Saturday of the same week, but not necessarily in the same order. None of them have the exam before Chinmayi and after Yamuna. Guna has the exam immediately after Anudeep and immediately before Divija. Esha has the exam on Tuesday and immediately before Anudeep.

Who among the following has the exam on Friday?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• The names of six graduate students are:
 
 
• Anudeep
 
• Yamuna 
 
• Chinmayi 
 
• Divija 
 
• Esha 
 
• Guna 
 
 
 
• There are 7 days in a week.
 
• None of them have the exam before Chinmayi and after Yamuna

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b02322f12474d0efc9daabf5da8e7328a25739c2d087f2579087728c68c28c5.png] 

 
• Esha has exam on Tuesday and immediately **before** Anudeep. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cd05dad4945c581729adda5efaf5e63bae7c54263ad04dc0608673f8b6f559e.png] 

 
• Guna has the exam immediately after Anudeep and immediately before Divija.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64edab9ec94b913994126925397c8a9075e8585530dec893c7fd82fbffc408a2.png] 

From the above arrangement, **Divija will be having an exam on Friday.**

Hence, the correct** **answer is **Divija**.
